name: odd-one-out
description: Finds places that deviate from the convention of the project itself: N times this way, once differently. Java, pom.xml, SQL migrations, JavaScript/TypeScript.

scripts.self-check: node bin/odd-one-out.mjs js . --json .odd-one-out/self-js.json && node bin/odd-one-out.mjs deps . --json .odd-one-out/self-deps.json
